diameterInterpretation: Convex light-curve shape with published thermophysical size calibration: 66.5 ± 0.9 km equivalent diameter. The nominal archived pole differs by 1° from the varied-model fit. Grid marks unavailable surface imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Reported symmetric VS-TPM uncertainty including varied shape/spin ensemble; not complete shape measurement accuracy
calibration.diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter from Hanuš et al. 2018 Table A.3, fit of WISE thermal observations using varied convex shape models from Hanuš et al.2016b
calibration.reference: Hanuš, Delbo, Ďurech and Alí-Lagoa (2018), Icarus 309,297–337, Table A.3; doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2018.03.016
calibration.limitations: The displayed nominal DAMIT2016 model has beta 50°, while the varied-shape thermophysical table reports beta 49° and rounded period 18.1191h. This transfer uses the same published shape/pole family, not identical thermophysical ensemble mesh bytes. Only a uniform physical scale is transferred; no thermal terrain or measured albedo map is added.
